title: Pandolfi's uncle a founding member of the OSS

tellings.quote: >> And uh he wants the information and it's shut down by Dr. Pandolfe, who by the way, his uncle Louis Pandolfe was a founding member of the OSS.

plain: A researcher named Jason Simosa says that a request for information was shut down by a Dr. Pandolfi, and that this man's uncle, Louis Pandolfi, was a founding member of the OSS, the American wartime spy agency that came before the CIA. Simosa relays this from others, citing the researcher Jacques Vallée and the interviewer Danny Jones, and he raises it to suggest family ties running deep into the intelligence world behind the people who guard UFO secrets.
